title: Corey AI Eye
style: Comedy phonk-pop with Sydney Aussie slang, bilingual English-Spanish licks, playful beatboxing, harmonic group vocals, and a sneaky panther groove; verse rides tight percussion and rubbery bass, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and mouth drums, chorus hits with stacked kid-and-grownup harmonies, call-response ad-libs, and cheeky crowd chants. Close-mic leads with doubled hook words, playful panning on laughs, ear candy from reversed whistles, beach-bag foley, and a glossy punchy mix with local-bus-window warmth., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey rolls in, yeah, right on time
Boots full scuff and a brain so prime
Sydney breeze in the servo queue
“Mate, I clock that” — yeah, see right through
Pink milk in the hand, lookin' kinda posh
“Sweet as, chief,” then he does that squash

[Pre-Chorus]
Eye on the pies, eye on the lies
Catches the sneaky stuff by surprise
Michelle goes, “bro, that’s mental, aye”
Ruby says, “vámonos, okay?”
Wesley laughs, “too easy, mate”
Then the whole crew bumps that fate

[Chorus]
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Sees all, aye aye
Corey AI eye (ojo)
Sneaky cat, go low
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Too clever, too sly
Corey AI eye (vamos)
Watch him glide by

[Verse 2]
Michelle with the grin and the deadpan stare
“Oi, that hat? That’s a state of air”
She sips that pink milk like it’s a prize
Then spots a prank in a bloke’s disguise
Ruby goes, “mira, that cheese is gone”
Then she giggles loud and the whole lane’s on
Wesley yells, “nah, that’s cooked, my dude”
Then does beatbox kicks with a tiny rude

[Pre-Chorus]
Handclap snap and a chinny chin
Corey reads the room, reads the mess you’re in
“Māte,” says Michelle, “he’s cooked your plan”
Ruby adds, “sí, he’s the man”
Wesley pops off with a little “choo-choo”
And the panther steps through, so suave, so true

[Chorus]
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Sees all, aye aye
Corey AI eye (ojo)
Sneaky cat, go low
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Too clever, too sly
Corey AI eye (vamos)
Watch him glide by

[Bridge]
[Beatboxing break]
Boom-tss, pff, ch-ka, huh
Michelle hums sweet, Ruby goes “la-la”
Wesley taps the desk, Corey tips his cap
“Too much brain?” — “Nah, mate, I’ve got that map”
Pink milk drip, cheeky little swirl
Four voices stack like a cyclone whirl
Corey leans in, says, “easy as, team”
Then the whole street laughs like a Saturday dream

[Final Chorus]
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Sees all, aye aye
Corey AI eye (ojo)
Sneaky cat, go low
Corey AI eye (eye, eye)
Too clever, too sly
Corey AI eye (vamos)
Watch him glide by

[Outro]
Sweet as, mate
Too easy, aye
Pink milk glow
Corey knows the play
